>> The dependency layering is that gpio.h can depend on devicetree.h, but not the other way around. Please rework the PR so that anything which need to know anything about the Zephyr GPIO API is not in devicetree.h or any of its sub-headers like this one.
>
> Ah, I got it, but then where would it be better to put this things:
> into the **drivers/gpio.h** or return it back into
> **drivers/gpio/gpio_utils.h** ?

I am only a devicetree maintainer, so the GPIO API is not my area of
responsibility. But FWIW I think the decision you have made in the
latest push makes good sense.

> @mbolivar-nordic should I also change the macro prefix from DT_GPIO_xx
> to GPIO_DT_xx, as is common in "drivers/gpio.h"? BTW it looks a bit
> confusing that we have two unrelated sets (DT_GPIO_ and GPIO_DT_) to
> describe parts of a whole.

This is intentional: the DT_ namespace is reserved for
<zephyr/devicetree.h>. So DT_GPIO_ is the namespace of macros in the
devicetree API that are somehow related to GPIOs. Defining a macro that
begins with DT_ outside of this header and its sub-headers is improper
use of the DT namespace.

The GPIO_ namespace belongs to <zephyr/drivers/gpio.h>. So GPIO_DT_ is a
namespace for GPIO APIs that are somehow related to devicetree.

The latest push uses the namespaces correctly.

> And as a consequence, is it acceptable to keep my tests in
> **tests/lib/devicetree/api**, or they have to relocated into the
> **tests/drivers/gpio/** ?


In the latest push, nothing is touching the devicetree API, so I agree
that tests/drivers/gpio is the correct location.

accordingly, but this is is not a blocking request.

issue_context.title: gpio: some drivers still use GPIO_PORT_PIN_MASK_FROM_NGPIOS macro the old way
issue_context.body:
GPIO drivers **drivers/gpio/gpio_ite_it8xxx2.c** and  **drivers/gpio/gpio_kscan_ite_it8xxx2.c** still use GPIO_PORT_PIN_MASK_FROM_NGPIOS macro the old way, as shown below:

        .port_pin_mask = GPIO_PORT_PIN_MASK_FROM_NGPIOS(              \
                           DT_INST_PROP(inst, ngpios))

while this usage has been deprecated and replaced by the newer style (in v2.3.0):


        .port_pin_mask =  GPIO_PORT_PIN_MASK_FROM_DT_INST(inst)             \


Or, even better, in the latest way:

        .port_pin_mask =  GPIO_PORT_PIN_MASK_FROM_DT_INST(inst)             \

As result driver are ignoring handling of the 'gpio-reserved-ranges' DT property value.

The patch is attached.

[gpio_ite_fix.txt](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/files/11264896/gpio_ite_fix.txt)
